categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the photovoltaic (PV) industry, focusing on four main segments: photovoltaic auxiliary materials (notably PV backsheet), high-efficiency solar cells (mainly n-type TOPCon cells), high-efficiency PV modules (components), and photovoltaic application systems including EPC services for distributed and ground-mounted PV power stations. These segments cover mid-to-downstream parts of the PV value chain.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as n-type TOPCon solar cell technology with proprietary POPAID and special injected metallization techniques to enhance efficiency and reduce power degradation. It produces double-sided coated backsheets with innovations like Hauberk technology for high UV resistance and transparency, and ceramic backsheets with high durability. Manufacturing is largely in-house with automated, intelligent production lines and integrated ERP, MES, and WMS systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global PV module manufacturers, EPC contractors, and end-users in distributed and centralized solar power markets. The company serves domestic Chinese markets extensively and exports to over 60 countries, with strong presence in Europe, the Middle East, Asia-Pacific, and emerging markets. It also collaborates with large state-owned enterprises and strategic partners for PV power station development.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover China extensively, including multiple provinces for distributed PV projects, and international markets including Europe, Middle East, Asia-Pacific, Australia, and the Americas. The company has subsidiaries and investments in countries such as Italy, Spain, Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, and Luxembourg.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the PV supply chain, producing key materials like backsheets, high-efficiency solar cells, and modules, as well as providing EPC services for PV power station construction and operation. It integrates auxiliary materials, cell and module manufacturing, and application services to offer comprehensive PV solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maintaining global leadership in PV backsheets, expanding auxiliary materials, advancing n-type TOPCon cell efficiency and capacity, and growing module production and overseas distribution. R&D focuses on innovative materials (e.g., ceramic backsheets, infrared blocking materials), cell metallization technologies, and next-generation module designs (e.g., low carbon, lightweight, high durability). The company invests heavily in patent development and collaborates with top research institutions globally.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of PV backsheets, solar cells, and modules, as well as EPC contracting services for distributed and centralized PV power stations. The company employs direct sales and distribution channels, with some products sold to subsidiaries for further processing. It also earns government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in PV backsheets, ranking first worldwide in shipment volume for consecutive years. It holds a strong position in high-efficiency n-type TOPCon solar cells and modules, competing with other top-tier PV manufacturers. Its integrated business model and technological innovations provide competitive advantages amid intensifying industry competition and market consolidation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 12.26 billion, a 28% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 526.5 million, up 31%. It has steadily expanded production capacity, including a 16GW high-efficiency monocrystalline solar cell factory under construction. The company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 17 billion and continues to invest significantly in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, technological leadership, and comprehensive PV solutions. Its backsheets offer superior durability, UV resistance, and transparency, enhancing module performance and lifespan. Proprietary cell metallization and TOPCon technologies deliver industry-leading conversion efficiencies and reliability. The integrated approach from materials to EPC services enables tailored, high-value offerings that reduce costs and improve energy yield for customers.
